title: twproject.json - an Audiosurf Tweaker script project
description: Built into one script by twllink. See Docs/scripting/authoring.md.

format.description: The manifest format. Always 1 for now.

id.description: The built script is <id>.lua. It is the script's identity to the plugin - do not change it once people have your script.

name.description: What the Scripts tab shows. One line.

author.description: Shown in the Scripts tab. One line.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, strictly: three whole numbers without leading zeros.

description.description: Shown in the Scripts tab. One line.

api.description: The tw.api_version the script is written against. A Tweaker with an older API refuses to run it.

comments.description: keep: modules go into the script as written. strip: comments are taken out, with their lines.

embed.description: Text files of the project carried inside the script as comments - a licence, design notes.

warnings_as_errors.description: Fail the build on any warning.

suppress.description: Warning codes to silence, e.g. TW0109. Errors cannot be suppressed.
